title: Battle of Camino Real
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Camino Real", at revision 1370436006, opens: "The Battle of Camino Real, was the first battle in the Ecuadorian War of Independence, that took place on 9 November 1820. The battle was fought between Royalist soldiers in support of the Spanish Empire, and the Patriot forces of the Free Province of Guayaquil, who won the battle." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3181490, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1820 battle of the Ecuadorian War of Independence". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
